about: Every document under valid/ and invalid/, and whether schemas/hil-results/v1.json accepts it. ouroboros-rest's hil.schema.spec.ts holds its embedded copy to these verdicts. An invalid document is not refused whole by the parser: the smallest enclosing measurement, case or suite is dropped with a warning (docs/TEST_RESULTS_INGEST.md).

cases.about: Mockup 11's rig: three cases, four measurements, trials, a bench.
The envelope alone — a rig that ran nothing.
A schema_version this build does not read — hil_schema_version_unknown.
A measurement with no limit — hil_measurement_incomplete.
A direction other than max or min — hil_measurement_incomplete.
A rig name that cannot be a platform tag — the document is dropped (hil_schema_invalid).
A case with no what-it-did line — the case is dropped (hil_schema_invalid).
